Name: Penny Enhanced Portraits
Author: Pixel4You
Description:
Description[b]Penny Enhanced Portraits[/b] replaces Penny’s default portraits with a fresh, expressive set of images that better capture her personality and emotions. The artwork features soft colors and refined details to blend naturally with Stardew Valley’s style, making conversations feel more immersive.
This mod is a [b]Content Pack for the Portraiture mod by Platonymous[/b], so it doesn’t overwrite any game files and supports high-resolution portraits seamlessly.
[line]Features[list]
[*]Custom high-quality portraits for Penny
[*]Matches Stardew Valley’s art style with added emotional depth
[*]Easy to install and use via the Portraiture mod interface
[/list][line]Requirements[list]
[*]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)
[*]Portraiture mod by Platonymous
[/list][line]How to Install[list=1]
[*][b]Download and install Portraiture[/b] (make sure SMAPI is installed first).

[*][b]Download the file[/b] [code]Penny.rar[/code] for this mod.

[*][b]Extract[/b] [code]Penny.rar[/code] using WinRAR, 7-Zip, or Windows Explorer.

[*]Inside the extracted files, locate the folder named [b]Penny[/b].

[*][b]Move the entire Penny folder[/b] into the Portraiture mod’s [code]Portraits[/code] folder:

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/[/code]
[quote]⚠️ If the [code]Portraits[/code] folder does not exist, launch the game once with Portraiture installed to create it automatically.[/quote]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley, then press [code]P[/code] in-game to open the Portraiture menu.

[*]Select [b]"Penny"[/b] from the list to enable the new portraits.

[/list][line]If you have any questions or need help with installation, feel free to ask!
